description: Tests the login functionality using GitHub OAuth integration, ensuring the user can authenticate and access their dashboard.
steps: Navigate to the login page at https://dev.roost.ai/login.
Locate and click on the GitHub login option.
Enter valid GitHub credentials (username and password).
Grant access to the application if prompted.
Redirect back to the primary application dashboard upon successful authentication.
Verify that the dashboard loads with user-specific data and environment management options.
expected_results: User is successfully redirected to GitHub's authentication page.
Upon entering valid credentials, user is redirected back to the application dashboard.
Dashboard displays user-specific options such as environment creation and monitoring.
edge_cases: Invalid GitHub credentials result in an error message.
User denies access to the application on GitHub's page.
Network issues during redirection to GitHub's page.
Session timeout on GitHub during login.
GitHub integration fails due to API downtime.
data_requirements: User account linked to the application.
Session data to track user login state.
dependencies: GitHub OAuth API must be operational.
User account must be pre-registered in the application.
api_interactions: Retrieve OAuth tokens from GitHub API.
Session validation API call upon successful login.
Environment listing API call to load dashboard data.
performance_metrics: Time taken to load the dashboard post-login.
API response time for environment retrieval.
accessibility_requirements: Ensure all login-related links and buttons are keyboard-navigable.
Validate ARIA roles and labels on the GitHub login button.
Provide screen reader-compatible error messages for failed login attempts.
